_comment: Live coverage of the rewritten !tz command (Claude interprets plain English, timezone_convert does DST-correct math). !tz is a direct command (not name-triggered) with a 10s cooldown, so each step waits 12s. Today is September so northern-hemisphere summer DST applies (London BST/UTC+1, New York EDT/UTC-4, Paris CEST/UTC+2).

steps.note: 1 source-only place, defaults target to UTC
5 gibberish -> graceful failure message (model declines the tool)
